title: Jobs created
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="job_queued" | stats count AS Jobs

title: Jobs completed
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="job_completed" | stats count AS Completed

title: Jobs failed
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="job_failed" | stats count AS Failed

title: Failure rate
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | stats count(eval(event="job_completed")) AS ok count(eval(event="job_failed")) AS failed | eval Rate=if(ok+failed>0,round(100*failed/(ok+failed),1),0) | fields Rate

title: Average processing time
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | stats avg(eval(if(event="job_completed",processing_duration_ms,null()))) AS Average | eval Average=round(Average,1)

title: P95 processing time
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | stats perc95(eval(if(event="job_completed",processing_duration_ms,null()))) AS P95 | eval P95=round(P95,1)

title: Jobs created, completed and failed over time
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | timechart span=1m count(eval(event="job_queued")) AS Created count(eval(event="job_completed")) AS Completed count(eval(event="job_failed")) AS Failed

title: Job status distribution
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | stats count(eval(event="job_queued")) AS queued count(eval(event="job_started")) AS started count(eval(event="job_completed")) AS COMPLETED count(eval(event="job_failed")) AS FAILED count(eval(event="job_failed" AND failure_stage="processing")) AS failedInWorker | eval QUEUED=max(0,queued-started), PROCESSING=max(0,started-COMPLETED-failedInWorker) | fields QUEUED PROCESSING COMPLETED FAILED | transpose column_name=Status | rename "row 1" AS count | where count>0

title: Average and P95 processing duration (ms)
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | timechart span=1m avg(eval(if(event="job_completed",processing_duration_ms,null()))) AS Average perc95(eval(if(event="job_completed",processing_duration_ms,null()))) AS P95

title: Queue time: average and P95 (ms)
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | timechart span=1m avg(eval(if(event="job_started",queue_time_ms,null()))) AS Average perc95(eval(if(event="job_started",queue_time_ms,null()))) AS P95

title: Most common failure reasons
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="job_failed" | stats count AS Failures BY failure_reason | sort - Failures

title: File type distribution
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="upload_received" OR (event="job_queued" AND isnotnull(demo)) | stats count BY file_type

title: API and worker CPU (%)
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="docuflow:container_metrics" | spath | foreach container_name container_status restart_count online_cpus cpu_percent memory_usage_mb memory_percent network_rx_rate_bytes_per_second network_tx_rate_bytes_per_second [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | eval cpu_percent=if(isnull(online_cpus),null(),cpu_percent) | timechart span=30s avg(cpu_percent) BY container_name

title: API and worker memory (MB)
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="docuflow:container_metrics" | spath | foreach container_name container_status restart_count online_cpus cpu_percent memory_usage_mb memory_percent network_rx_rate_bytes_per_second network_tx_rate_bytes_per_second [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | eval cpu_percent=if(isnull(online_cpus),null(),cpu_percent) | timechart span=30s avg(memory_usage_mb) BY container_name

title: Container status and restart count
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="docuflow:container_metrics" | spath | foreach container_name container_status restart_count online_cpus cpu_percent memory_usage_mb memory_percent network_rx_rate_bytes_per_second network_tx_rate_bytes_per_second [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | eval cpu_percent=if(isnull(online_cpus),null(),cpu_percent) | stats latest(container_status) AS Status latest(restart_count) AS Restarts latest(_time) AS LastSeen BY container_name | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename container_name AS Container

title: Restart count over time
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="docuflow:container_metrics" | spath | foreach container_name container_status restart_count online_cpus cpu_percent memory_usage_mb memory_percent network_rx_rate_bytes_per_second network_tx_rate_bytes_per_second [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | eval cpu_percent=if(isnull(online_cpus),null(),cpu_percent) | timechart span=30s max(restart_count) BY container_name

title: Network throughput (bytes/s)
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="docuflow:container_metrics" | spath | foreach container_name container_status restart_count online_cpus cpu_percent memory_usage_mb memory_percent network_rx_rate_bytes_per_second network_tx_rate_bytes_per_second [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | eval cpu_percent=if(isnull(online_cpus),null(),cpu_percent) | eval Throughput=network_rx_rate_bytes_per_second+network_tx_rate_bytes_per_second | timechart span=30s avg(Throughput) BY container_name

title: API response time excl. Splunk proxy: average and P95 (ms)
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" duration_ms NOT observability | spath | foreach status duration_ms method path service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) AND NOT like(path,"/api/observability%") | timechart span=1m avg(duration_ms) AS Average perc95(duration_ms) AS P95

title: Recent job failures
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="job_failed" | sort - _time | head 20 | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%H:%M:%S") | table Time job_id file_name failure_stage failure_reason

title: Slowest jobs
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="docuflow:application" (upload_received OR upload_rejected OR job_queued OR job_started OR job_completed OR job_failed) | spath | foreach event job_id job_status file_type demo failure_reason failure_stage processing_duration_ms queue_time_ms file_name service [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(event) | where event="job_completed" | sort - processing_duration_ms | head 10 | table job_id file_name file_type queue_time_ms processing_duration_ms
